desc: 轻量战术手持筒身，伸缩调焦加档位输出，走夜间野外场景
leaf: 轻量战术手持手电筒（伸缩调焦）
name: 轻量战术伸缩调焦手电筒款

shots.intent: 首屏用暗场掠射光把战术筒身的金属齿圈、滚花与散热鳍一次看清，抢搜索点击。
shots.textZone: top-left small-caps overline, two-line headline, one sub-line under a pine hairline rule

shots.intent: 用同一块湿地上手机冷光的一摊散光对比本品成形光锥，把夜间摩擦一眼放大。
shots.textZone: top headline strip, one short label under each panel

shots.intent: 高俯角双支交叉摆位，把筒身比例、铣平握位与尾部轮廓讲成造型卖点。
shots.textZone: left headline block, three callout labels on dashed leader lines

shots.intent: 三格同机位展示头筒伸缩带来的光型变化，把调焦机制讲懂。
shots.textZone: top headline, one short label per panel

shots.intent: 沿光轴正对镜头的微距，证明反光杯车纹、发光面与齿圈是真实工艺。
shots.textZone: right margin two callout labels, small-caps tag above them

shots.intent: 低机位仰拍雾夜野径上的真实光锥，把夜间野外可用感一次立住。
shots.textZone: top headline and sub-line, two placeholder token lines at left, weather pictogram column at right

shots.intent: 把多档输出做成一张可选台阶，收口选款疑问而不写任何亮度数值。
shots.textZone: top headline with a count token, three card labels

shots.intent: 五格真实夜间环境替代源图空灰块，让买家在露营夜骑寻路应急里对号入座。
shots.textZone: top headline plus one small-caps label per panel

shots.intent: 用雨淋后的真实水膜与头扣密封位微距建立耐用信任，不给任何防护等级数值。
shots.textZone: top headline, three construction labels on dashed leader lines

shots.intent: 以齿圈正面剪影加一句主张和按钮收口，把整套拉回下单动作。
shots.textZone: upper headline band and one pill button below the product

style.backgroundSystem: low-key screens sit on a seamless graphite field #16181B with one soft edge-lit pool behind the subject; daylight screens sit on a chamfered micro-cement shelf #D8DCDE with a visible 15mm thickness edge; the emitter, mode and spec screens reuse one technical graph-paper card #F1F2EF with hairline rules; a 01/04-style pagination mark, a corner close glyph and a vertical three-dot index repeat in the same corners across the set; no curtain folds, no stacked geometric podium garden, no blank placeholder tiles
style.direction: tactical outdoor-gear ecommerce, low-key metal study
style.iconSystem: bare single-weight hairline pictograms drawn directly on the field in #F1F2EF with a small-caps label beneath, no tiles and no tinted label bars; beam pictograms drawn as dashed cones and broken ray chevrons so the gradation from wash to throw reads as geometry; weather pictograms for fog, rain and clear sky; hairline dashed leader lines for callouts; a single pine marker #3F7A5E used only as a rule or a dot
style.lightingSystem: one hard key from the upper left at about 40 degrees with a deep unlit falloff on the shadow side, always paired with a low grazing specular sweep that opens up anodised micro-brushing, knurl teeth, head cooling slots, crenellated bezel and reflector taper; ambient stays cool at 6500K; the torch's own beam is the only practical light in night screens and is always a physical cone with a defined hot spot, visible atmospheric falloff and a shaped pool where it lands, never a solid glowing rod; one credible directional contact shadow under the body in every screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tactical outdoor-gear commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of graphite #16181B, gunmetal #3C4248, micro-cement moon-grey #D8DCDE and technical paper #F1F2EF, with one pine marker #3F7A5E and a lamp-gold #E9B44C reserved for the emitter hot spot only; cool colour temperature; condensed industrial grotesque typography with wide-tracked small-caps overlines; bare single-weight hairline pictograms drawn on the field with small-caps labels, dashed leader lines and a repeating 01/04-style pagination mark; alternating graphite and micro-cement backgrounds with one graph-paper card for emitter, mode and spec screens; one hard upper-left key at about 40 degrees with deep falloff plus a low grazing specular sweep so anodised aluminium, knurling, cooling fins, crenellated bezel and reflector taper read as true metal; the product's own beam always rendered as a physical cone with a hot spot and atmospheric falloff, never a solid glowing rod; stable body proportion and scale, always grounded with a credible contact shadow; chamfered micro-cement shelves instead of stacked podium geometry; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched pictogram styles.
noDrift: no lumen, candela, lux or wattage figures anywhere in copy or graphics
no beam-distance, throw or irradiation-angle numbers, no unit values at all, only placeholder tokens
no run time, charge time, battery capacity, cell type, cell count or chemistry
no water-ingress rating, no impact or drop rating, no glass-breaking or rescue promise
no certification, award, inspection report, standard number, origin or imported-emitter wording
no invented emitter, reflector, thread, seal, clip or switch that is not visible in the reference
no beam pointed at any person's face or eyes, no beam rendered as a solid glowing rod or neon bar
no child handling or holding the light, no damaged, swollen, loose or foil-wrapped cell, no open battery bay
no disassembly while live, no exposed wiring, no mains, panel or charging demonstration
no brand wordmark, store badge, QR code or membership corner tag
no solid-colour rainbow gradient backgrounds, no duplicated product elements, no floating product
style.presentationRules: one torch silhouette across the whole set: identical body-diameter to length ratio, identical head flare and cooling-fin pitch, identical knurl bands, identical milled grip panel, identical side-switch position and ring, identical tail-cap profile, identical anodised finish tone and identical bezel tooth count; a pocket clip or lanyard hole appears only if it exists in the reference, never added; the reflector taper and lens are drawn as they are; product never cropped, always grounded with a contact shadow; every scene screen carries one real scale anchor
style.surfaceSystem: chamfered micro-cement shelf #D8DCDE, wet graphite slab #16181B with a real thin water film and refracting droplets, matte graph-paper card #F1F2EF; anodised aluminium and stainless steel are rendered as true metal under raking light with hard micro-highlights, never as plastic sheen
style.typography: condensed industrial grotesque, one family only; heavy narrow headline 30-44pt in #F1F2EF on dark screens and #16181B on light screens, wide-tracked small-caps English overline at 12pt, tabular figures only inside placeholder tokens; Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets, one short idea per screen, no dense body text, no serif or rounded display faces
